candidates.name: Practice guide 72: development schemes
verified_facts: HM Land Registry development schemes can incorporate multiple parcels into a scheme title as land is acquired.
Separate interests or differing classes of title can require separate registration treatment.
semantic_limits: Scheme-title aggregation is registration structure only and cannot be used to infer parcel geometry, boundary precision or elevation values.

candidates.name: Notice 25: Permitted applications using the Digital Registration Service
verified_facts: The notice defines applications and transactions that may be lodged through HM Land Registry's Digital Registration Service.
It defines a development scheme as a registration arrangement incorporating several parcels into a single registered title.
semantic_limits: Eligibility for digital submission validates workflow format, not parcel geometry, legal-boundary precision or elevation accuracy.
